title: Scrolling page card with typed address
summary: A chrome-less landing page on a rounded card scrolls up and out, the domain types itself in the gap, then a dark section drops in, scrolls, and the page whips back to its hero so the last frame matches the first.
use_when: Showing off a finished marketing page or portfolio site in a short silent loop
Agency reels and client handovers where the page design is the product
A launch post that needs the domain on screen without an end card
Feeds that autoplay on loop: the last frame returns to the first

look.type_style: page: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, headlines about 4 % H; address line: medium grotesk, lowercase, about 5 % H, left edge fixed so the finished line sits centred

sfx.event: dark page card drops in from above
page whips back up to the hero

structure.shot: light page card (black header with 2-line headline over a pale glass image) scrolls to a work grid and exits up; domain types in on white
structure.camera: dolly: page travels up about 0.9 card heights 0.50 to 1.27, then card leaves through the top edge by 1.50 (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: page scroll easings.inOutSine 38 fr (±0.25 s); card exit easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); address typewriter from 1.10, ~22 cps, 16 chars done at 1.77; holds 15 fr; blur-out 2.50 to 2.83, 10 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dark page card drops from above: services list (12 lines, one bright, rest dim) then about block, then a dark hero with 2-line headline and a link
structure.camera: dolly: card drops from above the frame to top at 0.15 H, 2.77 to 3.77; inside it the page scrolls down to 5.77, then reverses
structure.motion: card entrance springs.heavy ~30 fr (overshoot not measurable); inner scroll easings.inOutSine, sections change at 4.50 and 4.77 (±0.25 s); reversal at 5.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: same card scrolls back fast through about, services with client logos, work grid and glass image to the light hero header
structure.camera: dolly with speed-ramp: content moves down slow at 6.50, about 640 px/s at 1920 W in 7.00 to 8.00, then about 110 px/s settling into the opening frame
structure.motion: reverse scroll easings.inOutCubic 37 fr (6.50 to 7.73, ±0.25 s); hero settles easings.outQuint ~30 fr to the 0.00 layout by 8.77

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the frame, fg for the address line, display font for the address
params.content.page: one full-length page capture (light hero first, at least one dark section), width 1440
params.content.url: domain typed in the gap, 10 to 20 characters; defaults to brand.url
params.content.stops: scrollY stops in page px: hero, work grid, dark section start, deepest point (4 values)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; card width 66 % of frame width at 16:9
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Page card is chrome-less (no browser bar): 66 % W, top at about 0.15 H, rounded corners about 1.6 % W, on flat white. Address typed from a fixed left edge: 7 chars at 1.27, 12 at 1.50, 16 at 1.77. Dark card enters 2.77 and settles by 3.77 with a long decelerating tail. Services list keeps one line bright and the rest dim, but it is static page design, not an animation. The catalogue hinted stacked-roll; the sheets show plain page scroll, so it is not tagged. Frame 8.77 matches 0.00, so the film loops. Proposed term page-scroll-loop (recipe.md). No audio in the reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
